application.question: What drove NVIDIA's full-year revenue growth in FY2026?
application.answer:
- NVIDIA’s FY2026 revenue, for the year ended January 25, 2026, rose 65% to $215.9 billion. [S10]
- The main driver was demand for accelerated computing and AI: Data Center revenue grew 68%. Data Center computing revenue increased 59%, driven by demand for the Blackwell computing platform. [S5] [S7]
- Data Center networking revenue grew 142%, driven by the introduction and ramp of NVLink compute fabric for GB200 and GB300 systems, plus growth in Ethernet and InfiniBand platforms. [S6]
- Other businesses also contributed: Gaming revenue grew 41% on strong Blackwell demand; Professional Visualization grew 70% on Blackwell demand and the launch of DGX Spark; Automotive grew 39% through continued adoption of NVIDIA’s self-driving platforms. [S5]
